text: [calm, natural narrator voice] Laboratory dynamos use liquid sodium. It flows as easily as water. But a field smudges in it about a hundred thousand times faster than its swirls do. Their ratio, one in a hundred thousand, is the magnetic Prandtl number, <|phoneme_start|>P IY1 EH1 M<|phoneme_end|>.
